en.title: ‘Shame and Money’ Director Visar Morina Delivers Gut-Punching Kosovo Drama
en.summary: Visar Morina's 'Shame and Money' has captivated audiences, winning the Grand Jury Prize at Sundance. This biting social drama dives deep into the struggles of a Kosovo family facing economic devastation.
en.body:
The Grand Jury Prize at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival was awarded to **Visar Morina**'s compelling new drama, **‘Shame and Money’**. This marks a significant triumph for the Kosovo-born director, whose previous work also found acclaim at the Sarajevo Film Festival. **‘Shame and Money’** is a searing portrayal of a family grappling with the harsh realities of economic disparity, presenting a narrative that is both deeply personal and universally resonant.

The film plunges viewers into the lives of a family in Kosovo whose existence is a constant battle against financial ruin. Director Morina, known for his realist approach, doesn't shy away from the difficult truths of poverty and its corrosive effects on familial bonds. The story serves as a stark reminder of the pressures faced by many communities worldwide, offering a critical look at the intersection of economic hardship and personal dignity. It’s a cinematic experience that demands attention and reflection, showcasing the director's unflinching commitment to authentic storytelling.

## A Look Into the Past, A Warning for the Future

Morina himself described the film as both a look into the past and a warning to the future, highlighting its thematic depth and relevance. He stated, "It’s a look into the past and a warning to the future." This sentiment underscores the film's ambition to not only depict a specific socio-economic situation but also to draw broader conclusions about societal vulnerabilities and the potential consequences of unchecked economic inequality. The film’s success at Sundance, a festival renowned for championing independent and socially conscious cinema, speaks volumes about its artistic merit and its ability to connect with a global audience.

## Why This Story Resonates Globally

In an era where economic instability is a constant concern for many, **‘Shame and Money’** strikes a powerful chord with audiences. The film’s unflinching realism and its focus on the human cost of financial struggle make it a vital piece of contemporary cinema. For fans of character-driven dramas and socially relevant filmmaking, Morina’s latest offering is a must-watch. It validates the power of cinema to illuminate difficult truths and foster empathy, proving that stories born from specific cultural contexts can indeed resonate across borders.

## What's Next

Following its triumph at Sundance, **‘Shame and Money’** is expected to see a wider release, with details yet to be announced. Fans eager to experience this award-winning drama should keep an eye on official announcements regarding its distribution and exhibition schedule.
